description: This file defines the interface SelfBeneficiariesTPTWritePlatformService, which declares methods for adding, updating, and deleting self-beneficiaries in a financial application.

classes.name: SelfBeneficiariesTPTWritePlatformService
classes.description: An interface providing methods to manage self-beneficiary accounts, such as add, update, and delete operations.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Handles creation of a new self-beneficiary record, taking a JsonCommand object as input and returning a CommandProcessingResult.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles updating an existing self-beneficiary record with details from the JsonCommand, returning a CommandProcessingResult.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of a self-beneficiary record, based on the provided JsonCommand, returning a CommandProcessingResult.
